Broadway Business Improvement District and its 155 businesses.

segments.title: Administration presents Broadway patio report
segments.takeaway: Administration presented a report on the Broadway Community Patio, explaining the request to waive parking fees and the current policy limitations.

segments.title: Broadway BID director speaks on patio fees
segments.takeaway: The Broadway Business Improvement District director requested a waiver or reduction of parking fees for the community patio, citing economic uncertainty and the project's benefits.

segments.title: Questions for Broadway BID director
segments.takeaway: Committee members asked the Broadway Business Improvement District director about the patio's maintenance responsibilities and funding details.

segments.title: Questions for administration on patio fees
segments.takeaway: Committee members questioned administration about the calculation of parking fees, the project's location, and the financial implications of fee reductions.

segments.title: Committee comments on Broadway patio
segments.takeaway: Committee members discussed the Broadway patio project, expressing support due to future city development and the project's community benefits, despite policy concerns.

segments.title: Motion to reduce Broadway patio fees
segments.takeaway: A motion was introduced to recommend to City Council a reduction in Broadway Community Patio parking fees from $11,975 to $4,622 per year for five years.

segments.title: Questions on Broadway patio fee reduction motion
segments.takeaway: Committee members questioned administration about the policy review, the impact of the fee reduction on other Business Improvement Districts, and potential precedents.

segments.title: Comments on Broadway patio fee reduction motion
segments.takeaway: Committee members commented on the motion, with some supporting it due to the administration's plan to review the policy, while others raised concerns about fairness to other BIDs and the process.

segments.title: Committee votes on Broadway patio motions
segments.takeaway: The committee voted on two motions regarding the Broadway patio: one to reduce fees (passed, chair opposed) and another to request information on avoiding impact on other BIDs (passed).
